service: operate one publication pulse against Koios's reader and outside-revenue outcomes
ingress: one ScheduleDelivery-delivered ActivityStreams Create<NewsroomIssueDemand> carrying Koios's standing internal order and an admitted delivery capability

revenueCounterparties: outside buyers of Koios publication products

internalPurchase.books: a bilateral receipt creates a Koios buyer debit and publication-operations seller credit

economicChain.nodeIncomeRule: publication operations sells each settled cycle to Koios and participates in externally evidenced article value-added after attributable costs
economicChain.consolidationRule: the internal buyer debit and seller credit eliminate one-for-one in Koios-wide profit; external receipts and outside costs do not
economicChain.zeroExternalValueRule: without reader or outside-revenue evidence, value-added payout is unproven and may be zero

transport.role: deliver the standing order on schedule and return the target receipt

deliveryCheck.rule: ScheduleDelivery checks whether Koios's standing order is due; Koios's issue controller alone decides whether the six-hour publication cadence admits work.
deliveryCheck.phaseRule: the delivery-check interval must remain shorter than the publication minimum so a successful issue cannot phase-shift the next opportunity by a whole cadence

preconditions: operate-issue is advertised by Koios with this exact contract
the issue controller settles the exact pulse before any newsroom work begins
only an accepted controller settlement may nominate the assignment supplied to the newsroom circuit
postconditions: a controller refusal is returned byte-for-byte as the terminal response
a newsroom refusal or obstruction returns one typed PublicationCycleSettlement naming the earliest observed failure and required next demand
editorially accepted work produces one verified production-indexable cutover candidate, never a shadow artifact
candidate formation returns a StaticPublicationDeliveryDemand and does not claim live publication before Cloudflare delivery settles
every terminal result is appended to Koios's contract-event ledger and is suitable for a ScheduleDelivery delivery receipt
prohibitions: ScheduleDelivery does not source, write, edit, publish, deploy, retry, or repair
the composed operation does not impersonate Newscable, Corpus Management, LISS, editorial assessment, or Cloudflare delivery
a local candidate is never represented as live public delivery
no hidden provider fallback and no ambient customer or provider filesystem authority
an internal sale, invoice, effort, or completed cycle is never represented as outside revenue or external user value
ScheduleDelivery transport is never represented as the economic customer

currentClosure.newsroom: executing only where its sovereign provider carriers are reachable
currentClosure.cloudflareDelivery: executing through cloudflare-primary-static-release/v1; candidate formation is deliberately settled by a subsequent low-memory pulse
